footer: Tiqora is a RISC-V microcontroller for a Tiny Tapeout 3x2 tile on SkyWater sky130. Nothing on these pages has run on real silicon or a real FPGA board; every number says how it was obtained.

flow.title: Tiqora: what enters, what happens inside, what comes out
flow.desc: Program and data come from the QSPI Pmod's flash and RAM through the QSPI controller and the bus to the nibble-serial RV32E core. Pin edges enter the timing unit, which the core drives with Xpulse instructions. Triggers, flags and UART TX leave on uo_out.

nodes.label: uo_out[7:0]
lines: TRIG0, TRIG1 on the exact tick

ladder.note: Each rung needs the one below it.

rungs.why: 493 checks in 18 suites and 6 cocotb tests from the pins (make -C test sim, verify-audits 2026-10-26); the official RISC-V tests, 37/37 (make act, main 2026-10-25); the recorded tour, 15/15 (make -C test tour).
No formal proofs exist for this design. The repository has no SymbiYosys or other formal set-up.

50,880 µm² of sky130 cells, 1,191 flip-flops: 44% of the 3x2 die (make area, Yosys 0.33, main 2026-10-25, with the cells this design's flow excludes removed). Gate-level simulation of that netlist: 5 pass, 1 skipped by design (make gl).
3x2 at placement density 50: the gds and precheck workflows pass, and the cocotb tests pass on the routed netlist (gl_test) (GitHub run 40213473443, LibreLane 3.0.14, commit 7bee2a9).

Routed: setup slack +6.45 ns at the typical corner, -0.26 ns at nominal slow and -0.75 ns at the worst slow corner (22 paths); hold met at every corner (measured, local LibreLane 3.0.14 run of src/config.json, 2026-10-26; DRC 0, LVS 0, antenna 0). At 50 MHz it meets timing on typical silicon; the slowest corner needs about 20.8 ns (an estimate from the slack).
A clean GDS and the Tiny Tapeout pre-flight exist at 3x2 (GitHub run 40213473443, LibreLane 3.0.14). Submitting it is the owner's step.
No chip exists, so there are no silicon measurements and no photographs on these pages.

ladder.target: CPU / GPU / TPU modes build (FPGA and full sky130 chip only)
ladder.note: Compiled only with -DTIQORA_MODES; the Tiny Tapeout tile's gate netlist is byte-identical without it (bash syn/tile_identity.sh).

rungs.why: 230 checks over seeds 1 to 6, 8 of 8 mutants caught (make -C test modes); the Basys 3 design in simulation, 9 checks and a 25-line transcript matching sw/modes_model.py.
70,679 µm² flat (MODES=1 bash syn/area_sky130.sh, Yosys 0.33): 62% of the 3x2 die, never tried in layout.
Needs a larger die than any Tiny Tapeout tile set considered so far.
26 checks over four programs (make -C fpga/basys3 sim, v20).
Yosys 0.70, nextpnr-xilinx and prjxray build one and its netlist passes 4/4 at the board pins. Not a Vivado build, so no Vivado timing sign-off.
Nothing has run on a real Basys 3.

fpga.title: Tiqora on a Basys 3: the demo program, simulated
fpga.inside: RV32E core, timing unit, UART; flash and RAM emulated in block RAM
fpga.note: Recorded from RTL simulation, not a board: fpga/basys3/tb_basys3.sv runs sw/examples/basys3_demo.c on the whole board design (make -C fpga/basys3 record; its 6 checks pass). Timing is shortened for simulation: the UART runs at 8 clocks per bit, and LED 0 toggles every 40,000 ticks instead of every 25,000,000. Nothing has run on a real Basys 3.
